title: Seiko 5 Sports SRPD Series
desc: The definitive modern entry to automatic horology. We chose the SRPD for its bulletproof NH36 movement and the legendary 4 o'clock crown. Note: It gains/loses a few seconds daily — that's mechanical charm, not a defect.
img_alt: Editorial illustration: stainless steel automatic dive-style watch with a navy dial.

title: Invicta Pro Diver 5053
desc: Powered by Seiko's NH35a automatic calibre with a genuinely tested 200m water resistance. A classic, high-contrast coin-edge bezel dive watch that punches way above its price tag for daily wear and ultimate durability.
img_alt: Editorial illustration: stainless steel dive-style watch with a black dial.

title: Citizen Eco-Drive Chandler
desc: The ultimate set-it-and-forget-it light-powered field watch. Built with absolute rugged durability for a seamless minimalist daily rotation.
img_alt: Editorial illustration: field watch with a dark dial and olive fabric strap.

title: Casio G-Shock GA-2100 'CasiOak'
desc: An absolute icon in modern watch design. Features the legendary G-Shock shock resistance wrapped in a slim, octagonal carbon core guard structure. The indestructible daily beater for minimalists.
img_alt: Editorial illustration: black octagonal resin sport watch worn on the wrist.

title: 14oz Heavyweight Boxy Hoodie
desc: Dropped shoulder, dense knit construction. Holds shape after repeated washes — most hoodies at this price don't.
img_alt: Editorial illustration: heavyweight black boxy hoodie worn outdoors.

title: Salomon Speedcross 6 Trail Shoes
desc: The benchmark in functional Gorpcore footwear. Features an aggressive Mud Contagrip lug pattern that anchors a minimalist technical outfit flawlessly without looking purely like standard running shoes.
img_alt: Editorial illustration: dark trail-running shoe with deep lugs on a forest path.

title: Carhartt Rugged Flex Heavyweight Overshirt
desc: The ultimate structured layering piece for transition seasons. Built from rugged, heavy-grade cotton twill with stretch canvas that acts as the hard-wearing foundation for the classic three-piece casual capsule wardrobe formula.
img_alt: Editorial illustration: tobacco-brown canvas overshirt worn in a workshop.

title: Shaka Wear 7.5oz Max Heavyweight Tee
desc: Cut from ultra-dense 7.5 oz matte-finish cotton built specifically for the minimalist aesthetic. A tight, retro mock-neck collar ensures the silhouette stays perfectly structured even after intensive daily rotation.
img_alt: Editorial illustration: heavyweight black crew-neck T-shirt.

title: UGREEN Revodok Max 13-in-1 Dock
desc: True 40Gbps Thunderbolt 4 throughput. Runs dual 4K displays without the bandwidth compromises cheaper docks make.
img_alt: Editorial illustration: aluminum USB-C docking station beside a laptop.

title: Logitech Lift Vertical Mouse
desc: A genuine ergonomic improvement, not just a marketing angle — noticeable after a few full work days.
img_alt: Editorial illustration: charcoal vertical ergonomic mouse on a wood desk.

title: Sony WH-CH720N Noise Canceling Headphones
desc: Active noise cancellation that actually improves call clarity from inconsistent work environments.
img_alt: Editorial illustration: black over-ear headphones on a desk mat.

title: Single-Monitor Vertical Stand
desc: Eye-level mounting that keeps a one-screen setup from feeling like a compromise.
img_alt: Editorial illustration: single monitor on a black adjustable arm.
